execution.modelIdentity: Codex conversational model; no external provider model ID claimed

sections.heading: When pressure narrows your access
sections.text: Pressure built gradually. Your attention narrowed to one thing, and your energy felt keyed up and drained at once. The change became clear only afterward. At first, answering people became harder. You went somewhere with less input and could carry on, but still did not feel better. In the same episode, you knew what you meant and wanted to speak, but the words would not come.

sections.heading: Functioning before feeling settled
sections.text: A familiar task remained possible while you looked steady and felt strained inside. You could function before feeling more settled; being on edge remained difficult.

sections.heading: Later, more room to think and choose
sections.text: Later, you spent time with less noise or fewer demands and had more room to think and choose.

sections.heading: How the easing unfolded
sections.text: You estimated that the first easing came more than two hours after you noticed the pressure, within the same day. After the later attempt to get some room back, the setting had become quieter or less demanding. As things eased, less input or demand came before words became easier, and clearer thinking followed.

sections.heading: Some things became easier
sections.text: At one point, more than one next step came into view. Some things became easier, but not all. After easing, the concern still made sense but felt less urgent.

claims.text: As pressure built gradually, your attention narrowed to one thing, your energy felt keyed up and drained at once, and you recognized the changes afterward.
claims.rationale: D29.narrow, D32.both, D33.later, and D82.gradual directly record narrowed attention, simultaneous keyed-up/drained energy, after-the-fact recognition, and gradual build.
remaining_uncertainty: This is one recalled occurrence and does not establish frequency, cause, or a general condition.

claims.text: In the same recalled occurrence, you knew what you meant and wanted to speak but could not get the words out.

scope.description: Speech access within the same actual-recalled overload occurrence.

claims.rationale: D30.stuck and D34.words, in the same occurrence, record knowing what was meant and wanting to speak while being unable to get the words out.
remaining_uncertainty: The packet does not identify a protective intention behind this loss of access.

claims.text: A familiar task remained available and you looked steady while feeling strained; you could function before feeling settled, while feeling settled remained difficult.

scope.description: Capacity, outward/inward comparison, and ease within one actual-recalled overload occurrence.

claims.rationale: D80.task retains the ability to carry out a familiar task; D81.steady_strained separates appearance from felt strain; D85.function_first places functioning before settling; D83.settle records residual difficulty feeling settled.
remaining_uncertainty: Task performance does not identify a motive or show that the strain had ended.

claims.text: The first easing was estimated as more than two hours after the pressure was first noticed, but within the same day.

scope.description: Respondent estimate of time to first easing in one actual-recalled overload occurrence.

claims.rationale: D84.later_day selects more than two hours but within the same day for time from first noticing pressure to first remembered easing.
remaining_uncertainty: This is an approximate time to first easing, not a total recovery duration or evidence of full recovery.

claims.text: Around a later attempt to get room back, the setting had become quieter or less demanding.

scope.description: A respondent-identified environmental condition in the same recovery episode.

claims.rationale: D86.setting identifies the setting as quieter or less demanding after the later attempt to get some room back.
remaining_uncertainty: The response records a surrounding condition; it does not show that this condition caused any specific recovery change.

claims.text: In the remembered recovery order, less input or demand came before words became easier, and clearer thinking followed the easier words.

scope.description: Only the two adjacent before relations encoded for D36 in one actual-recalled recovery sequence.

claims.rationale: The selected D36 options and both current packet edges preserve input before words and words before thinking. No other order is added.
remaining_uncertainty: These edges record remembered temporal order, not that reduced input caused the later changes.

claims.text: At a recovery marker, you could consider more than one next step.

scope.description: First recovery marker, with more than one next step available, in one actual-recalled occurrence.

claims.rationale: D35.choice is captured as a recovery marker and directly records considering more than one next step. It is not combined with later partial-easing or appraisal observations as though all were simultaneous.
remaining_uncertainty: This marker does not establish a full recovery endpoint or the timing of every other recovery observation.

claims.text: At the first mapped step, answering people became harder. You went somewhere with less input and reported that you could carry on but did not feel better.

scope.description: The original-authored first Mapping step in one actual-recalled occurrence; the observations share the same dependence group.

claims.rationale: Original-authored M10.words, M11.quiet, and M12.function are all bound to the same first step and occurrence. Their capture roles record first notice, first action, and immediate effect; the wording preserves that reported order without adding a sequence edge or asserting that less input caused the ability to carry on or any felt improvement.
remaining_uncertainty: These observations come from one dependent occurrence and do not establish a recurring response or a causal effect of lower input.

claims.text: Later in the same account, you spent time with less noise or fewer demands and reported more room to think and choose.

scope.description: The original-authored later Mapping step in the same actual-recalled occurrence; these observations share the same dependence group.

claims.rationale: Original-authored M13.quiet and M14.choice are both bound to the later step of this occurrence and record a lower-noise/fewer-demands action and more room to think and choose. No causal edge, placement within the separate D36 order, or identification with the first easing time is inferred.
remaining_uncertainty: The packet does not establish what caused the reported increase in room or that this relationship recurs.

claims.text: Some things became easier, but not all.

scope.description: Reported partial return after easing in one actual-recalled occurrence.

claims.rationale: D37.part directly reports that some things were easier but not all. This records partial easing after easing and does not establish a total recovery endpoint or duration.
remaining_uncertainty: This does not establish a full recovery endpoint or exact total duration.

claims.text: After easing, the concern still made sense but felt less urgent.

scope.description: Respondent appraisal after easing within one actual-recalled occurrence.

claims.rationale: D100.same_less is explicitly captured as meaning after easing and directly reports that the concern remained meaningful but felt less urgent.
remaining_uncertainty: This post-easing appraisal does not establish that the concern was mistaken or that the easing was complete.
